summary: Shopify OrderDisplayFulfillmentStatus can return FULFILLMENT_NOT_REQUIRED as of 2026-10
details:
As of Admin API version 2026-10, Order.displayFulfillmentStatus can return FULFILLMENT_NOT_REQUIRED for orders with nothing left to fulfill (cancelled or refunded before fulfillment), which returned UNFULFILLED before.

Handle FULFILLMENT_NOT_REQUIRED wherever the code maps or filters displayFulfillmentStatus, and stop treating these orders as UNFULFILLED.
